summary: Smoke tested Chanda Manager MVP — backend /api endpoints and mobile-first frontend flows. Backend: seed idempotent, dashboard totals correct (voided excluded), CRUD/void/unvoid/status transitions (collected_at stamping/clearing), collectors, backup all working. Frontend: Dashboard KPI renders with ₹ INR (₹11,151), Add form submits and redirects to /list with success toast, void confirm modal opens+cancels, Reports preview shows 10 entries / ₹13,137 with column checkboxes, Settings lists 5 collectors and backup/restore buttons render, bottom nav navigates across all 5 tabs.
passed: POST /api/seed idempotent (returns seeded:false when data exists)
GET /api/dashboard totals (expected 10904, collected 10152, pending 752, by_payment_mode + by_collector populated)
POST /api/chanda creates with collected_at auto-stamped for Collected
PUT /api/chanda/{id} — Collected stamps collected_at, Pending clears it
GET/POST /api/collectors — 4 seeded collectors returned; dedupe on POST
Frontend Dashboard loads with dashboard-page testid and ₹ formatted total
Add flow: fills name/amount, uses add-new-collector-toggle, submits, redirects to /list, toast shown, entry visible in list
List search filters entries; void-btn opens void-confirm-modal; void-cancel-btn closes it
Reports page loads with filters + column checkboxes + preview count/total
Settings page loads with 5 collector rows and backup/restore controls
Bottom nav (dashboard/add/list/reports/settings) navigates correctly; FAB add visible
notes: Radix Select for collector in Add form was not clickable via role=option (native select fallback used add-new-collector-toggle path successfully). PDF/Excel/CSV export click was not exercised per instructions (trivial). Restore window.confirm flow not automated.
